_: Identity system MVP (sub-project B): a lightweight class/identity system. Each identity = a FACT (held signal) + priority + optional grants/acquire. THREE FACES: Acquire (read a tome → MFIdentityBook OnRead joins the faction + grants an ability + plays a scene), Grant (a standing Fortify ability while you hold the identity), Gate (identity/primaryIdentity dialogue tags → GetInFaction CTDA so NPCs treat you by your identity). Headline: the Paladin oath reuses the just-shipped PlayIdle scene-action (an oath-keeper BOWS and blesses you). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-06-identity-system-design.md.

magicEffects.name: Oath of the Eight
magicEffects.description: Your oath steadies your sword arm.
magicEffects._: A constant-effect Fortify One-Handed: the Paladin's standing grant. ValueModifier/OneHanded, ConstantEffect/Self, Recover flag so the bonus is restored (not a one-shot). Detrimental NOT set (it's a buff).

spells.name: Oath of the Eight
spells._: The Paladin's standing ability (spellType=Ability, ConstantEffect/Self). Granted on join, removed on leave by MFIdentityBook. +20 One-Handed while held — check in-game with `player.getav onehanded` or the Active Effects menu.

perks._: SMITE EVIL (Phase-2 #5 'smite 細調'): the Paladin's conditional bonus — +25% weapon damage vs UNDEAD or DAEDRA. A ModAttackDamage entry point (Multiply 1.25) whose effect-level conditions check the TARGET (runOn:Target) for ActorTypeUndead (0x013796) OR ActorTypeDaedra (0x013797) — `or:true` on the FIRST so it reads 'undead OR daedra'. Granted via the identity's grantPerks; the tab-count CTD byte is set automatically. playable:false/hidden — it's script-granted, not a skill-tree perk.
perks.name: Smite Evil
perks.description: Weapon damage against undead and daedra is increased by 25%.

books.name: Oath of the Eight Divines
books._: Reading it (MFIdentityBook OnRead, attached automatically via identities[].acquireBook) joins MF_FactPaladin, grants MF_AbilSmite, and starts the oath scene.
books.text: Kneel, and swear: my blade to the weak, my breath to the Eight. Read these words to take the oath.

books.name: Trader's Ledger
books._: A TOGGLE identity: reading it joins MF_FactMerchant; reading it again leaves it.
books.text: Mark your goods, tally your coin. Read to take up the trade — or read again to set it down.

identities._activeWhen: SITUATIONAL gate (Phase-2 #2): the Paladin identity only counts as ACTIVE while these CTDA pass — here, while the player wears HEAVY ARMOR. You stay a faction member (getfactionrank>=0) after reading the book, but the paladin greeting/gates only fire in plate. Each condition runs on the PLAYER by default. NOTE the documented gap: while held-but-inactive (book read, no heavy armor) the lower Adventurer greeting is still excluded on the faction signal, so the NPC falls back to its plain greeting until the Phase-2 controller resolves primary by activeWhen too.

identities._: BASELINE identity every player holds from game start — no book to read. A StartGameEnabled quest (MFIdentityDefault) auto-joins MF_FactAdventurer on first load (and on existing saves via the .seq). priority 0 so any acquired identity outranks it as the primary greeting.

DRAGONBORN (autoGrantWhen): no book — a poll controller (MFIdentityAutoGrant) joins MF_FactDragonborn once the player's DragonSouls ActorValue >= 1 (your first absorbed dragon soul; vanilla GetActorValue, no SKSE). priority 40 (above Paladin) so once it triggers, Dragonborn becomes your primary identity and NPCs hail you as such.

classes.name: ModForge Townsfolk
classes._: REQUIRED for the NPCs: autoCalcStats derives H/M/S from the class+level. WITHOUT a class the calc yields ~0 health and an essential NPC spawns in permanent bleedout (looks dead — you'd have to `resurrect` it). Health-weighted so they have real HP.

factions._: Vendor faction for the Townsfolk so the Merchant-only `openBarter` trade option has real goods/gold. always-on-duty hours; sellBuyList is the vanilla VendorItem keyword list (notSellBuyList=true → sells everything BUT those categories). Chest = MF_ShopChestRef.
factions.name: ModForge Townsfolk Goods

containers.name: Merchant Chest
containers._: The vendor's gold + stock (shown in barter). 800 gold to buy your wares; a couple of items to sell.

npcs.name: Oath-Keeper
npcs.greeting: Speak your oath when you are ready.

npcs._: The escort-quest giver. Holds two packages: a Follow gated on GetStage(MF_EscortQuest)==10 (only follows while the escort is active) and a Stand sandbox fallback. Adventurer-only dialogue starts the escort.
npcs.name: Wary Traveler
npcs.greeting: These roads aren't safe to walk alone.

packages._: Follow the PLAYER (target empty = player), but ONLY while the escort quest is at stage 10. Listed before the stand sandbox on the NPC so it wins when its GetStage condition passes. accompany=true keeps the traveler close.
Stand-at-spot fallback when not escorting (stage != 10). NearSelf anchors at the placed position; no wandering.

quests._: Host quest for the oath scene + the identity-gated dialogue. StartGameEnabled so both are live.
quests.name: ModForge Identity Showcase

quests._: Escort quest (Phase-2 #5b). StartGameEnabled (runs at stage 0); the Adventurer-gated dialogue sets stage 10 (traveler follows), 'we've arrived' sets stage 20 (complete + reward). The follow package is gated on GetStage==10.
quests.name: A Traveler's Escort

stages.logEntry: I agreed to escort the wary traveler to safety.

scenes._: Triggered SOLELY by MF_PaladinTome's OnRead → AcquireScene.Start(). beginOnQuestStart=false so the scene NEVER auto-plays at game load — no begin-condition gate needed (the old condition+forced-Start dance was fragile; the book's Start() is the one clean trigger, same as the autoStart controller uses). The oath-keeper BOWS (PlayIdle, reuses scene-playidle) and blesses you.

lines: Rise, sworn of the Eight. Your blade is theirs now.

dialogue._: GREETINGS that vary by identity: `hello:true` makes these the NPC's auto-spoken greeting (Misc/Hello), not a player menu option. The engine plays the highest-priority Hello whose conditions pass; primaryIdentity gates each on the player's faction (paladin excludes lower-priority ids). If no identity Hello matches, the NPC falls back to its plain `greeting` ('Hm?').
responses: Well met, paladin. The Eight smile on you.
A fellow trader, well met. Coin to coin.

dialogue._: Dragonborn greeting (autoGrantWhen showcase): fires once Dragonborn is your primary (priority 40, after your first dragon soul). Highest priority, so it outranks paladin/merchant unless you manually override.
responses: Dragonborn... the old tales were true, then. Honored, I am.

dialogue._: BASELINE greeting — fires when the player holds no higher identity (i.e. only the default Adventurer). primaryIdentity excludes Paladin/Merchant, so this replaces the plain 'Hm?' fallback before any book is read.
responses: Safe travels, adventurer. The road is long.

dialogue._: MANUAL OVERRIDE options (Phase-2 #4): picking one sets the MF_IdentityOverride global via a TIF result fragment; the MFIdentityController makes that identity your PRIMARY (how NPCs greet you), overriding the auto highest-priority resolution. Each is gated with `identity` so it only appears when you actually hold that identity. 'auto' clears the override.

dialogue.prompt: I'm a merchant; treat me as one.
Address me however you see fit.

dialogue._: IDENTITY-SPECIFIC INTERACTION (Phase-2 #5a): a Merchant-only trade option. openBarter → a TIF result fragment calls (speaker as Actor).ShowBarterMenu(). identity:Merchant gates it so only a fellow merchant sees it; the Townsfolk is a vendor (MF_TownsfolkShop faction + MF_ShopChest), so the barter shows real gold/stock.
responses: Coin to coin. Take a look.

dialogue._: IDENTITY-SPECIFIC INTERACTION (Phase-2 #5b): an Adventurer-only ESCORT offer. identity:Adventurer gates it; setStage 10 starts MF_EscortQuest (the follow package GetStage==10 then matches); evaluateSpeakerPackages makes the traveler start following immediately. Auto-hides after stage 10 (setStage's GetStage<10 condition).
dialogue.prompt: I'm an adventurer — I'll see you safely on your way.
responses: Thank the gods. Lead on, I'll keep close.

dialogue._: Escort completion: only at stage 10 (explicit GetStage==10 + setStage's GetStage<20). setStage 20 completes the quest + the rewardItem gives 200 gold; evaluateSpeakerPackages stops the follow (stage no longer 10).
responses: Safe at last. Here — for your trouble.

placements._: The vendor's merchant chest (holds the gold/stock shown in barter). persistent so the vendor faction's MerchantContainer link + VendorLocation resolve.
